name: Keith Self

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NATIONAL DEFENSE AUTHORIZATION ACT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2027
statements.title: NATIONAL DEFENSE AUTHORIZATION ACT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2027
sentences: This is a military readiness, religious liberty, and command support bill.
This bill builds upon the truth that has been affirmed by the Supreme Court that the First Amendment rights of our military chaplains are not suspended at the doors of the Pentagon.

Despite existing protections in the First Amendment, the Religious Freedom Restoration Act, RFRA, and section 533 of the FY 2013 NDAA, chaplains continue to face obstacles for simply ministering according to their faith.
This is why the Religious Freedom Restoration Act unanimously passed to protect religious freedom, and mainly religious minorities, in 1993.
They are the commanders' adviser on ethics, spiritual readiness, morale, and even suicide prevention.
It also introduces real accountability under the Uniform Code of Military Justice for retaliation or censorship of a chaplain for acting according to their beliefs.
Mr. Chair, I rise today in support of my amendment, which would attach the Military Chaplains Modernization Act of 2026 to the NDAA.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FEDERAL PROGRAM INTEGRITY AND FRAUD PREVENTION ACT OF 2026

statements.title: TEHRAN INCITEMENT TO VIOLENCE ACT

Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of my bill, H.R. 6230, the Tehran Incitement to Violence Act.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: UKRAINE SUPPORT ACT
statements.title: UKRAINE SUPPORT ACT
sentences: It went into the spectrum, they have not offered us an AUMF or a declaration of war.
The Ukraine Support Act is filled with mandatory sanctions provisions that would significantly constrain the President in his negotiations with Russia.
The Ukraine Support Act is also riddled with problems that my colleague Mr. Hill has already mentioned, problems that call its credibility into question.
In one section, the bill extends the Ukraine Security Assistance Initiative at $300 million per year for fiscal years 2026 and 2027, yet Congress has already authorized $400 million.
I ask my Democrat colleagues: Do you support cutting assistance to Ukraine in addition to tying the President's hands?
The bill also includes a sense of Congress encouraging NATO allies to spend at least 2 percent of GDP on defense.
Is your intent to reduce the commitment of NATO member nations?
They are watching this debate right now, and they are advocating for 2 percent.
Regardless of what they say, the bill has 2 percent in it.
Vladimir Putin would love you for that, especially after President Trump successfully worked with our allies to raise their commitment to 5 percent.
Mr. Speaker, for this reason and many others, I urge my colleagues to vote ``no'' on the Ukraine Support Act.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in opposition to H.R. 2319.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT PURSUANT TO SECTION 5(C) OF THE WAR POWERS RESOLUTION TO REMOVE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM LEBANON
statements.title: DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT PURSUANT TO SECTION 5(C) OF THE WAR POWERS RESOLUTION TO REMOVE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM LEBANON
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I wasn't planning on speaking on this issue, but as I have listened to this anti-Israel screed, I have to ask why my colleagues across the aisle don't pay nearly as much attention to the ongoing slaughter in South Sudan?
The change in the Democratic Party over the last few years has been extraordinary, in their change of their attitude toward Israel.

I won't describe them because everybody remembers, but I would recommend that when terrorists, bona fide terrorists, commit atrocities such as we saw on October the 7th several years ago, I would recommend they don't live stream them because if anybody has watched the films that were taken that were live streamed by the perpetrators, they would question this very discussion about Lebanon and about Israel's defense of itself.
Israel is doing the U.N. job that UNIFIL was put there to do, to keep Hezbollah north of the Litani River, and the U.N. force refused to do their job.
We have Israeli families who can't live in their homes in northern Israel, so Israel is doing the U.N.'s job, as well.
I think, as I have listened to this anti-Israel screed, we need a little historical balance in this discussion.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: REAFFIRM THE PRINCIPLES OF LIBERTY BY DISMANTLING THE SURVEILLANCE STATE
statements.title: REAFFIRM THE PRINCIPLES OF LIBERTY BY DISMANTLING THE SURVEILLANCE STATE
sentences: Third, close the data broker loophole that allows the FBI, IRS, and every other Federal agency to bypass the Constitution by simply buying Americans' geolocation, metadata, and browsing history off the market.
Most urgently, require a warrant for backdoor searches of Americans' communications.
In addition, we must ban the Central Bank Digital Currency permanently.
The CBDC is the ultimate surveillance tool that allows the government to track, control, and potentially freeze every purchase you make.
Look, as the gentleman said, we support surveillance on foreign actors on foreign soil, and with a warrant, we support law enforcement to do what they need to do with a warrant.
I want to tell you a story about facial recognition.
They agree to that, but that same capability will pick you out of a crowd with AI facial recognition.
Law enforcement is now going and demanding--when they think there has been a crime that this camera might have seen, demanding that they be allowed to see what that Ring doorbell recorded.
It is one of the most surveilled nations in the world, and that is before we get to CBDC.
We are facing a social credit score if all of this happens: the kill switch, CBDC, and warrantless surveillance on your electronic communications.
Any FISA reform that does not include a permanent ban on CBDC and securing our elections, I believe, does not cut the mustard.
I will say that I consider the CBDC, the central bank digital currency, the final leg in the surveillance state stool.

The intelligence community wants a clean reauthorization, but we are not going to accept that, Congress should not accept that, and no American, if they were actually told the truth for once about what their own government is doing to them, would accept that.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: EXTENSION OF AUTHORITIES OF TITLE VII OF THE FOREIGN INTELLIGENCE SURVEILLANCE ACT OF 1978
statements.title: EXTENSION OF AUTHORITIES OF TITLE VII OF THE FOREIGN INTELLIGENCE SURVEILLANCE ACT OF 1978
sentences: I want to reiterate my colleague's comments that we are really dealing with two surveillance bills here today. 702 is getting all of the attention, but the central bank digital currency is another surveillance tool that we sent to the Senate.
The electronic surveillance is 702, foreign agents on foreign soil.
The central bank digital currency is financial transparency for the Federal Government.
All of the attention is on 702, but do not take your attention off CBDC.
Mr. Speaker, let's get 702 reauthorized with constitutional protections, and let's also address the central bank digital currency.

statements.title: DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT, PURSUANT TO SECTION 5(c) OF THE WAR POWERS RESOLUTION, TO REMOVE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM HOSTILITIES WITH IRAN
sentences: There are three priorities of the regime in Iran.
We have neutered Iran, which has been at war with us for 47 years.
Mr. Speaker, I will address a couple of things that my esteemed colleague across the aisle talked about.
I have been deployed on three continents with the United States Army, and I will tell you the support of the American people is what sustained you when you are deployed overseas.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SHARIA-FREE AMERICA
statements.title: SHARIA-FREE AMERICA
sentences: I am delighted to announce that the caucus now has representation from 25 States across the United States, which is half of all the States in this Union.
An imam in Dallas called the police on a fellow Muslim for merely speaking to a Christian pastor.

The Islamist terrorist, a naturalized citizen from Senegal with prior arrests, wore a sweatshirt proclaiming: ``Property of Allah,'' an undershirt bearing an Iranian flag, and left a Koran in his vehicle.
Its nations enforce these rules, from Iran's reign of terror to places where adultery brings stoning, apostasy brings death or public floggings, and men and women live in slavery.

If you don't believe this is happening, Mr. Speaker, then tell that to the thousands of British teenage girls groomed, plied with alcohol, gang-raped by Muslim gangs, and then arrested by police for being drunk while their rapists go free.
According to Islam, many non-Muslims like me are regarded as infidels, and Muslims who convert to Christianity or any other faith are apostates, punishable by death under Islam.

Seven bills stand ready to ban sharia's influence regarding immigration and legal systems, deporting adherents who promote it, designating the Muslim Brotherhood and CAIR as terrorist organizations, strengthening vetting, advancing the PAUSE Act to stop all immigration, and ensuring no court ever considers sharia or any foreign religious code.

Most alarming of all, according to a former senior Plano law enforcement official, there is speculation that there are unattended deaths in this Muslim-only community that are not being reported, as required under State law.

It is a parallel society, a de facto sharia enclave operating in defiance of full assimilation into American law, situated immediately adjacent to the very law enforcement facilities meant to protect our communities.
Alarmingly, and as a matter of fact, the pattern of Islamic centers being built next to police training facilities is emerging.

America welcomes people of every faith to come to live under our Constitution and assimilate into our society, but we will never tolerate a system that creates submission-based enclaves, exclusive housing markets, or fortresses overlooking our police academies.
We cannot allow that fate here in the United States.
Mr. Speaker, I urge every colleague, Republican or Democrat, who believes in American sovereignty to join the Sharia-Free America Caucus today.
I urge every colleague who values American sovereignty to join the Sharia-Free Caucus today.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SHOOTING IN AUSTIN, TEXAS
statements.title: SHOOTING IN AUSTIN, TEXAS
sentences: First of all, I have been aware of and been involved in Iran since 1979.
I also was involved in Iran in 1984, when the 82nd Airborne Division was preparing Op Plan 1004.
I have been cognizant of and aware of Iran and planning for Iran since the late seventies, since the ayatollah took over.
Investigators found him wearing a sweatshirt emblazoned with ``Property of Allah'' and an undershirt featuring an Iranian flag design, and recovered a Koran from his vehicle.
The FBI is investigating this as having a potential nexus to radical Islamic terrorism tied to U.S. actions involving Iran.
The symbols were unmistakable and intentional: ``Property of Allah,'' references to Iran, and a Koran at the scene.
It arrived here through failed vetting and immigration loopholes.
Let us strengthen vetting to keep out those who adhere to sharia.

We do not want to get to the position where Great Britain is where they have rape gangs that kidnap young girls off of the street, take them and fill them full of drugs and alcohol, rape them mercilessly, and then the police arrest the young women for being drunk in public.
We will not surrender our freedoms.
I urge every colleague, Republican and Democrat, who believes in American sovereignty to join us.
It reaches the accommodation phase: Yes, we will pray in the middle of the street.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT PURSUANT TO SECTION 5(C) OF THE WAR POWERS RESOLUTION TO REMOVE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM UNAUTHORIZED HOSTILITIES IN THE ISLAMIC REPU
statements.title: DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT PURSUANT TO SECTION 5(C) OF THE WAR POWERS RESOLUTION TO REMOVE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM UNAUTHORIZED HOSTILITIES IN THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN
sentences: I thought we were talking about the War Powers Act and not the Democrats' social programs.
President Trump's decision to strike Iran is not starting a forever war.
For half a century, the Islamic Republic of Iran has cast a shadow over the Middle East and trapped the region in a dark age.
When the regime chants ``death to America, death to Israel,'' they mean it.
Iran has slaughtered more Americans than any other terrorist regime in the world, and they will continue to kill Americans until they are stopped.
Iran is the number one sponsor of terrorism in the world by nonstate actors, something that is not even contemplated by the War Powers Act.
For years, Iran has leveraged these terrorists to wage war against and kill Americans and countless civilians throughout the region.

Just last weekend in my home State, a gunman horrifically killed three innocent people and injured four others in Austin, Texas, while reportedly wearing a sweatshirt that read ``Property of Allah'' and a shirt with an Islamic Republic of Iran flag on it.
While law enforcement continues its investigation into a connection with the Islamic Republic, Americans must understand the enemy is within the gates.

The current regime in Iran is the poster child for Islam and sharia law, a culture of violence and domination that is totally incompatible with individual freedoms, our Constitution, and our heritage.
Furthermore, the Iranian people have overwhelmingly demonstrated a clear will to overthrow and change the radical regime.
By giving the green light to Epic Fury, President Trump is giving the Iranian people a fighting chance to alter the course of history in the Middle East and the world.
Finally, I would also like to note that since the War Powers Act was enacted, every President, both Republican and Democrat, has agreed that this law is unconstitutional.
Mr. Speaker, while I agree that this body should engage in discussions about the War Powers Act, this is not the appropriate time.
That is what I am going to do.
I urge my colleagues to oppose this resolution.

statements.title: DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT, PURSUANT TO SECTION 5(c) OF THE WAR POWERS RESOLUTION, TO REMOVE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM HOSTILITIES WITH PRESIDENTIALLY DESIGNATED TERRORIST ORGANIZATIONS IN THE...
sentences: These drug cartels, especially Tren de Aragua, are behind much of the drug trafficking, human smuggling, and violent crimes that are tearing communities apart and fueling the opioid crisis in America.

The intention of this resolution may be to stop the attacks on the drug boats, but by refusing military action against presidentially designated terrorist organizations, you shut the door for action against other dangerous groups, including Mexican cartels or Islamic terrorist groups that might want to establish themselves or attack elsewhere in the Western Hemisphere.

Instead of considering this resolution, which carries little or no consequences for hostilities that don't exist, this Chamber should focus on supporting the President's efforts to deter the growing national security threat from Venezuela.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in opposition to this resolution.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to oppose this resolution.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: REMOVAL OF THE USE OF UNITED STATES FORCES FOR HOSTILITIES WITHIN OR AGAINST VENEZUELA
statements.title: REMOVAL OF THE USE OF UNITED STATES FORCES FOR HOSTILITIES WITHIN OR AGAINST VENEZUELA
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in strong opposition to this resolution, which is not necessary, as it removes our Armed Forces from hostilities against a country where there have been no hostilities.
The War Powers Act has no legal bearing on actions that could happen in the future.
To date, there are no confirmed U.S. servicemembers engaged in combat with Venezuela.

While I could end it there, since Democrats are turning a blind eye to the killing of Americans by illicit drugs from Venezuela, I also highlight that Venezuela has become a strategic outpost for China, Russia, and Iran, not to mention criminal and terrorist organizations.
Not only has Maduro's regime purchased Iranian-armed drones, but they have also allowed Iran to establish production facilities for its military drones within their borders.
Russia, a longtime ally of the regime, still provides Venezuela with military aid while also facing the challenges of waging war in Ukraine.
In fact, Venezuela opened a factory last summer to manufacture Russian Kalashnikov rifle munitions.
China, Russia, Iran, and Cuba use the country as a platform for intelligence operations in asymmetric warfare.

Instead of considering this resolution, which carries little or no consequences for hostilities that do not exist, this Chamber should focus on supporting the President's efforts to deter the growing national security threat from Venezuela.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to oppose this resolution.

As the chairman of the Europe Subcommittee of the Foreign Affairs Committee, I will continue to lead both reauthorization of the State Department and regional efforts under the leadership of Chairman Mast.
